dialogue.text: (The TV drones in the background. A bottle cap hits the floor.)
(The phone rings. He picks up before the second ring.)

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: It's the middle of the night, retard.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.text: Um… The deadline of the finalized documents has been changed.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: You want me to give you a star sticker for this update?

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.text: It’s… set for tomorrow before noon.

choices.text: Step up and help your team.
Pass the responsibility to someone else.
